La luz llega en paquetes, los fotones, d: Light arrives in packets, photons, with energy $E = h f$. A photon knocks an electron out of the metal only if its energy exceeds the work function $W_0$, and the excess is kinetic energy: $E_{c,max} = h f − W_0$ (Einstein, 1905). Below the threshold frequency $f_0 = W_0/h$ no electron comes out however intense the light; more intensity gives more electrons, not faster ones. The stopping potential satisfies $e V_0 = E_{c,max}$.
De Broglie propuso en 1924 que toda part: In 1924 de Broglie proposed that every particle has an associated wave, of wavelength $λ = h/p$. For an electron accelerated through a few hundred volts it is the size of atoms, and it diffracts in crystals; for a ball it is so small that nothing is noticeable.
Si la velocidad de la luz es la misma pa: If the speed of light is the same for everyone, time and space depend on the observer. With $γ = 1/√(1 − v^2/c^2)$, a moving clock runs slower, $Δt = γ Δt_0$, and a moving object is shortened in the direction it moves, $L = L_0/γ$. The total energy is $E = γ m c^2$, with $m c^2$ the rest energy, and the kinetic energy is $(γ − 1) m c^2$. Muons created in the upper atmosphere reach the ground thanks to time dilation.
